Triangular diagonal alpha^j and fixed point alpha^k contraction prove exact power limit; every quantifier and boundary is specified. Checker is only finite diagnostic.

value.rationale: The restriction matrix is a central building block of an actual 2026 fast spectral Volterra construction; one-step gain Theta(N^1/4) and long-power gain Theta(N^1/2) show distinct degree-dependent sensitivity invisible from its eigenvalues. Contrasting uniform Lebesgue L2 control identifies the specific endpoint-weight mechanism. Quantitative stability limits can inform norm selection and high-degree recursive restriction; not merely an isolated arithmetic check.
